issue_title: Bug: Integrity check reports false positives for assets with non-ASCII filenames (NFC/NFD Unicode normalization mismatch)
symptom_report:
The integrity check reports `untracked_file` for assets that exist on disk, when filenames contain non-ASCII characters.

Root cause: the path stored in the database is NFC-normalized, while the on-disk filename is NFD-normalized (common on macOS filesystems such as APFS/ExFAT). The integrity check compares paths byte-by-byte without Unicode normalization, so every file with decomposed characters is flagged as untracked even though it is fully indexed (thumbnail, preview, checksum all present).

Verified: the flagged files exist on disk with SHA-1 checksums identical to the database — they are the same files, just with different Unicode normalization.
